nodes.description: Focused radiation produces progressive vascular injury and eventual nidus obliteration over a latency period. Hemorrhage remains possible before obliteration, and radiation-related injury is an additional risk. A 101-patient retrospective pediatric cohort reported 64% estimated obliteration at five years and 82% at ten years, with permanent symptomatic radiation changes in 8%. A separate prospective TOBAS SRS registry reported three-year occlusion in 51/79 patients with imaging, or 54% of all 94 analyzed patients.
